key: FLORINIA: ...
en: FLORINIA: ...
ja: フロリニア: ……

key: Please notice...
en: Please notice...
ja: ……気づいてくれ……

key: HEATHER: What are you doing, you stupid creep?!
en: HEATHER: What are you doing, you stupid creep?!
ja: ヘザー: 何してんのよ、キモいやつ!?

key: Let go of me already!
en: Let go of me already!
ja: さっさと離しなさいよ!

key: SIGMUND: The subject lashes out with verbal and physical aggression, and refuses to listen to either instruction or reason.
en: SIGMUND: The subject lashes out with verbal and physical aggression, and refuses to listen to either instruction or reason.
ja: シグムンド: 被験体は言語的・身体的な攻撃性を示し、指示にも道理にも耳を貸そうとしない。

key: Let's begin an initial treatment at 100 volts.
en: Let's begin an initial treatment at 100 volts.
ja: 初期治療は100ボルトから始めるとしよう。

key: ANNA: Oh, it WAS you!
en: ANNA: Oh, it WAS you!
ja: アンナ: あ、やっぱりあんただったんだ!

key: Your light shines brightest in the darkness after all!
en: Your light shines brightest in the darkness after all!
ja: あんたの光は、暗闇の中でこそ一番輝くんだね!

key: So make sure you never, ever, ever stop shining, no matter what happens~
en: So make sure you never, ever, ever stop shining, no matter what happens~
ja: だから、何があっても絶対絶対輝くのをやめないでね~

key: I know this is a little backwards, but just hang in there, okay?
en: I know this is a little backwards, but just hang in there, okay?
ja: ちょっと順番が逆だけど、それでも頑張ってね、いい?

key: She should open a path for you...
en: She should open a path for you...
ja: あの子が、あんたのために道を開いてくれるはずだから……

key: Unless...
en: Unless...
ja: ……もっとも……

key: Hey, \PN?
en: Hey, \PN?
ja: ねえ、\PN?

key: If two stars fall, passing like ships in the night, do you think they would wish upon each other?
en: If two stars fall, passing like ships in the night, do you think they would wish upon each other?
ja: もし二つの星が、夜にすれ違う船みたいに流れ落ちたら、お互いに願いをかけると思う?

key: If that would happen, then which wish would win?
en: If that would happen, then which wish would win?
ja: もしそうなったら、どっちの願いがかなうのかな?

key: Maybe we just have to chase them to the horizon to find out!
en: Maybe we just have to chase them to the horizon to find out!
ja: それを知るには、地平線まで追いかけるしかないのかもね!

key: CAIN: Oh, geez, there you are.
en: CAIN: Oh, geez, there you are.
ja: カイン: あー、よかった、いた。

key: It's really you this time, right?
en: It's really you this time, right?
ja: 今度は本物のお前だよな?

key: I lost you before, and I've been seeing some really weird stuff down here...
en: I lost you before, and I've been seeing some really weird stuff down here...
ja: 前にはぐれちゃって、ここでずっと変なものを見てたんだ……

key: Earlier, I saw a version of you... but I think it was from the past?
en: Earlier, I saw a version of you... but I think it was from the past?
ja: さっき、お前のバージョン違いみたいなのを見たんだけど……あれ、過去のお前だったのかな?

key: You didn't seem to even see me at all.
en: You didn't seem to even see me at all.
ja: オレのことなんて、全然見えてない感じだった。

key: It was pretty cold.
en: It was pretty cold.
ja: けっこう寂しかったよ。

key: But I thought we were gonna stick together, ahaha...
en: But I thought we were gonna stick together, ahaha...
ja: でも、一緒にいようって言ったじゃんか、あはは……

key: Listen... I keep feeling like there's something just behind me.
en: Listen... I keep feeling like there's something just behind me.
ja: なあ……何かがずっとオレのすぐ後ろにいる気がするんだ。

key: So really... Stay close this time, okay?
en: So really... Stay close this time, okay?
ja: だから本当に……今度はそばにいてくれよ、な?

key: Let's go slow together.
en: Let's go slow together.
ja: ゆっくり一緒に行こう。

key: KIKI: Welcome, once more.
en: KIKI: Welcome, once more.
ja: キキ: ようこそ、また会いましたね。

key: I return as well, striking in perfect immobility, with all the fury that my soul may harbor.
en: I return as well, striking in perfect immobility, with all the fury that my soul may harbor.
ja: わたしもまた戻ってきました。完全な静止の中で、この魂に宿るあらゆる怒りを込めて。

key: Because that is all I can amount to.
en: Because that is all I can amount to.
ja: それが、わたしにできることの全てだから。

key: "Defeat the inner chaos?"
en: "Defeat the inner chaos?"
ja: 「内なるこんとんを打ち破る?」

key: Did you think I was only talking about zen of the mind?
en: Did you think I was only talking about zen of the mind?
ja: 心の禅について語っているだけだと、そう思ってました?

key: I could be centered to dead-zero and I will still end up--
en: I could be centered to dead-zero and I will still end up--
ja: どれだけ心を完全に無にしたって、結局わたしは――

key: AYA: Please stop fighting!
en: AYA: Please stop fighting!
ja: アヤ: 戦うのやめて!

key: Please come back...
en: Please come back...
ja: 帰ってきて……

key: I'll clean my room and won't complain anymore--
en: I'll clean my room and won't complain anymore--
ja: 部屋も片付けるし、もう文句も言わないから――

key: I'll do anything I need to, just... Please...
en: I'll do anything I need to, just... Please...
ja: 何でもするから、だから……お願い……

key: Love each other again?
en: Love each other again?
ja: また、お互い好きになれない?

key: AYA: So you finally left too, huh.
en: AYA: So you finally left too, huh.
ja: アヤ: とうとうあんたも出ていくんだ。

key: Tch.
en: Tch.
ja: チッ。

key: I know I'm a toxic person, but you could at least say "bye" first.
en: I know I'm a toxic person, but you could at least say "bye" first.
ja: あたしが最低な女なのは分かってるけど、せめて「じゃあね」くらい言ってよ。

key: But I guess that's just what I deserve.
en: But I guess that's just what I deserve.
ja: ま、それがあたしにお似合いってことか。

key: CAIN: Oh... It really is just you, isn't it...
en: CAIN: Oh... It really is just you, isn't it...
ja: カイン: あ……本当にお前だけなんだな……

key: This place is running me a bit ragged...
en: This place is running me a bit ragged...
ja: この場所、ちょっとオレをすり減らしてきてるよ……

key: And not in the good way.
en: And not in the good way.
ja: それも、いい意味じゃなくてさ。

key: If I keep seeing things about you, probably you've seen some things about me too.
en: If I keep seeing things about you, probably you've seen some things about me too.
ja: オレがお前に関することをずっと見せられてるなら、たぶんお前もオレに関する何かを見てるんだろうな。

key: To be honest, I'd rather just forget about most of that stuff.
en: To be honest, I'd rather just forget about most of that stuff.
ja: 正直、そういうのはほとんど忘れたいけどな。

key: Well, obviously that's why I ran, ahah...
en: Well, obviously that's why I ran, ahah...
ja: まあ、だからこそ逃げてきたわけだけど、あはっ……

key: But then, the only place I ever ran was in circles.
en: But then, the only place I ever ran was in circles.
ja: でも結局、逃げてもぐるぐる同じところを回ってただけだった。

key: I guess it's hard to do anything else when you don't know where to go.
en: I guess it's hard to do anything else when you don't know where to go.
ja: どこに行けばいいか分かんないと、他に何もできないもんだよな。

key: Do you know what you want to do in the future?
en: Do you know what you want to do in the future?
ja: お前は、これからどうしたいか分かってる?

key: Like, after this is all over?
en: Like, after this is all over?
ja: ほら、全部終わったあとにさ?

key: CAIN: Yeah~? I'm not too surprised.
en: CAIN: Yeah~? I'm not too surprised.
ja: カイン: そう~? あんまり驚かないな。

key: CAIN: Then I guess we're made for each other after all~
en: CAIN: Then I guess we're made for each other after all~
ja: カイン: それじゃ、やっぱりオレたちお似合いってことか~

key: So many people seem like they're just cut out and set on whatever it is they want to do, but I never was like that.
en: So many people seem like they're just cut out and set on whatever it is they want to do, but I never was like that.
ja: みんな、やりたいことがはっきり決まってるみたいに見えるけど、オレは一度もそうじゃなかったな。

key: Ahaha, I can barely settle on a romantic partner.
en: Ahaha, I can barely settle on a romantic partner.
ja: あはは、恋人一人決めるのだって一苦労だし。

key: Even with how much I joke and flirt about that stuff,
en: Even with how much I joke and flirt about that stuff,
ja: あんなに冗談言ったり口説いたりしてるくせにさ、

key: It's just a way of keeping myself safe from commitments and disappointment,
en: It's just a way of keeping myself safe from commitments and disappointment,
ja: あれって結局、本気になることとガッカリすることから自分を守る手段なんだよな、

key: If those are even any different.
en: If those are even any different.
ja: まあ、その二つに違いがあるならの話だけど。

key: Who knows~
en: Who knows~
ja: さあね~

key: Maybe one day I could find somewhere I actually can feel like I belong.
en: Maybe one day I could find somewhere I actually can feel like I belong.
ja: いつか、本当に居場所だって思える場所が見つかるのかもな。

key: Place or person-- either way.
en: Place or person-- either way.
ja: 場所でも、人でも――どっちでもいいよ。

key: But I've gotten around enough to know that I'm the problem-- not them.
en: But I've gotten around enough to know that I'm the problem-- not them.
ja: でも色々経験して分かったんだ、問題があるのは相手じゃなくてオレの方だって。

key: Even if they do nothing wrong, I still never feel like I can stay.
en: Even if they do nothing wrong, I still never feel like I can stay.
ja: 相手が何も悪いことしてなくても、留まれる気がしないんだ。

key: But hey, everyone's a little bit broken, right?
en: But hey, everyone's a little bit broken, right?
ja: でもまあ、誰だってちょっとは壊れてるもんだろ?

key: And some pieces just don't fit together.
en: And some pieces just don't fit together.
ja: パズルのピースがはまらないことだってあるさ。

key: No matter how much lotion...
en: No matter how much lotion...
ja: どれだけローション使ったって……

key: Well, never mind!
en: Well, never mind!
ja: まあ、なんでもない!

key: You can go on ahead this time.
en: You can go on ahead this time.
ja: 今回はお前が先に行けよ。

key: Sticking together never works out anyway.
en: Sticking together never works out anyway.
ja: どうせ一緒にいたってうまくいかないしな。

key: And maybe, just this time, I'll stop running.
en: And maybe, just this time, I'll stop running.
ja: それに、今回だけは、逃げるのをやめてみるよ。

key: CAIN: I think I've got some thinking to do...
en: CAIN: I think I've got some thinking to do...
ja: カイン: ちょっと考えることがありそうだな……

key: But don't be afraid to call me up later~
en: But don't be afraid to call me up later~
ja: でも、あとで気軽に連絡してよな~

key: SIGMUND: We meet again.
en: SIGMUND: We meet again.
ja: シグムンド: また会ったな。

key: I have no intention of extending to you the same mercy as when last we met.
en: I have no intention of extending to you the same mercy as when last we met.
ja: 前回会った時と同じ慈悲を、お前にかけるつもりはない。

key: I am here to reclaim what has been stolen from me.
en: I am here to reclaim what has been stolen from me.
ja: 私は奪われたものを取り戻しに来た。

key: Lizzy, Lizzy...
en: Lizzy, Lizzy...
ja: リジー、リジー……

key: I will do what must be done for your sake.
en: I will do what must be done for your sake.
ja: お前のために、なすべきことをなすまでだ。

key: SIGMUND: Lizzy, Lizzy...
en: SIGMUND: Lizzy, Lizzy...
ja: シグムンド: リジー、リジー……

key: SIRIUS: Blast that feral woman!
en: SIRIUS: Blast that feral woman!
ja: シリウス: あの野蛮な女め!

key: And blast her husband twice.
en: And blast her husband twice.
ja: その夫にはさらに二倍の呪いを。

key: History cares nothing for hopeless romanticism.
en: History cares nothing for hopeless romanticism.
ja: 歴史は、救いようのないロマンチシズムなど気にも留めない。

key: He is as naive as I've been.
en: He is as naive as I've been.
ja: 奴は、かつての私と同じく浅はかだ。

key: For neither does history care for its own study.
en: For neither does history care for its own study.
ja: 歴史は、自らへの探求すら気にかけないのだからな。

key: I only needed to recover the scars I carved, not earn my own.
en: I only needed to recover the scars I carved, not earn my own.
ja: 私はただ、自ら刻んだ傷跡を取り戻せばよかった。新たに自分の傷を負う必要などなかったのだ。

key: But I understand now.
en: But I understand now.
ja: だが、今は分かる。

key: Reality accepts nothing less than full commitment and sacrifice.
en: Reality accepts nothing less than full commitment and sacrifice.
ja: 現実は、全身全霊の献身と犠牲以外、何も受け入れはしない。

key: Those unwilling to choose that path have it chosen for them.
en: Those unwilling to choose that path have it chosen for them.
ja: その道を選ぼうとしない者には、代わりにその道が選ばれる。

key: Then there's only one road left to walk.
en: Then there's only one road left to walk.
ja: ならば、歩むべき道は一つしか残っていない。

key: Ironic.
en: Ironic.
ja: 皮肉なものだ。

key: Perhaps this loss was just what I needed to gleam the way.
en: Perhaps this loss was just what I needed to gleam the way.
ja: この敗北こそが、道を照らすために必要だったものなのかもしれない。

key: SIRIUS: History is written by the winners.
en: SIRIUS: History is written by the winners.
ja: シリウス: 歴史とは、勝者によって書かれるものだ。

key: And I have written too much already.
en: And I have written too much already.
ja: そして私は、すでに書きすぎた。

key: Then there is only one choice.
en: Then there is only one choice.
ja: ならば、残る選択肢は一つだけだ。

key: LIN: How funny.
en: LIN: How funny.
ja: リン: おかしなものね。

key: You thought you were strong together.
en: You thought you were strong together.
ja: みんなでいれば強いと思っていたのね。

key: And here you are now.
en: And here you are now.
ja: それで今、あなたはここにいる。

key: Let this be a lesson.
en: Let this be a lesson.
ja: これを教訓にするといいわ。

key: Numbers do not help.
en: Numbers do not help.
ja: 数は助けにならない。

key: Friends do not help.
en: Friends do not help.
ja: 友も助けにならない。

key: Nothing ever helps.
en: Nothing ever helps.
ja: 何一つ助けにならない。

key: No one ever helps.
en: No one ever helps.
ja: 誰も助けにならない。

key: No one ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever helps.
en: No one ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever helps.
ja: 誰も誰も誰も誰も誰も誰も誰も誰も助けになんてならない。

key: ???: Once upon a time, a belt of meteors swept across the universe.
en: ???: Once upon a time, a belt of meteors swept across the universe.
ja: ???: 昔々、ひとつの流星群が宇宙を駆け抜けていました。

key: But one day, one of those little meteors decided she wanted to go further than any of the others ever had.
en: But one day, one of those little meteors decided she wanted to go further than any of the others ever had.
ja: でもある日、その中の小さな流れ星が一つ、誰よりも遠くへ行きたいと思ったのです。

key: So she kicked up her trail, revved up her spacedust, and off she went,
en: So she kicked up her trail, revved up her spacedust, and off she went,
ja: だから彼女は尾を蹴り上げ、宇宙のちりを吹かして、飛び出していきました。

key: Sailing far, far away across the galaxy,
en: Sailing far, far away across the galaxy,
ja: 銀河を越えて、遠く遠くまで飛んでいって、

key: Further than all her best friends,
en: Further than all her best friends,
ja: どの親友よりも遠くへ、

key: Further than all her loving family,
en: Further than all her loving family,
ja: どの愛する家族よりも遠くへ、

key: Further than any meteor had ever known it was possible to even go.
en: Further than any meteor had ever known it was possible to even go.
ja: どんな流れ星も行けるとは知らなかったほど、遠くへ。

key: And when she was very, very tired of flying so far away, she found a little planet she liked, and she thought that she would finally rest.
en: And when she was very, very tired of flying so far away, she found a little planet she liked, and she thought that she would finally rest.
ja: そして、そんなに遠くまで飛んでとても疲れた頃、彼女は気に入った小さな惑星を見つけて、ようやく休めると思いました。

key: So, the little meteor started to descend to the planet's surface.
en: So, the little meteor started to descend to the planet's surface.
ja: そうして、小さな流れ星は惑星の地表へと降り始めました。

key: But that planet's atmosphere was so hot, and so thick,
en: But that planet's atmosphere was so hot, and so thick,
ja: でもその惑星の大気は、とても熱くて、とても濃くて、

key: And the little meteor was so exhausted from flying so many millions and millions of moons across space...
en: And the little meteor was so exhausted from flying so many millions and millions of moons across space...
ja: それに小さな流れ星は、宇宙で何百万、何百万もの月日を飛び続けてすっかり疲れ果てていました……

key: ...That she burnt right up in the sky!
en: ...That she burnt right up in the sky!
ja: ……だから彼女は、空でそのまま燃え尽きてしまったのです!

key: And do you know what happened?
en: And do you know what happened?
ja: それで、何が起きたと思います?

key: All the people on that planet looked up, and they said,
en: All the people on that planet looked up, and they said,
ja: その惑星の人々はみんな空を見上げて、こう言いました。

key: "Look!
en: "Look!
ja: 「見て!

key: A shooting star!
en: A shooting star!
ja: 流れ星だ!

key: Let's make a wish!"
en: Let's make a wish!"
ja: 願い事をしよう!」

key: And so, everyone on that little planet,
en: And so, everyone on that little planet,
ja: そうして、その小さな惑星のみんなは、

key: Which had scarcely seen such a star in its life,
en: Which had scarcely seen such a star in its life,
ja: 生まれてこの方、そんな星をほとんど見たことがなかったから、

key: Wished,
en: Wished,
ja: 願いました、

key: And wished, and wished, and wished with all their might,
en: And wished, and wished, and wished with all their might,
ja: 願って、願って、力の限り願いました、

key: And those people smiled, and knew hope like they had never known before, and felt happy.
en: And those people smiled, and knew hope like they had never known before, and felt happy.
ja: そしてみんな微笑んで、これまで知らなかったような希望を知って、幸せを感じたのです。

key: And by the time it would have come to the surface, there was nothing of the little meteor left at all...
en: And by the time it would have come to the surface, there was nothing of the little meteor left at all...
ja: そして地表に届く頃には、小さな流れ星は、もう何も残っていませんでした……

key: It had all-- poof!-- vanished!
en: It had all-- poof!-- vanished!
ja: すっかり――ぽん!――消えてしまったのです!

key: And even though it disappeared from the world forever, do you know what that little meteor did?
en: And even though it disappeared from the world forever, do you know what that little meteor did?
ja: そうして世界から永遠に消えてしまったけれど、その小さな流れ星が何をしたか、分かりますか?

key: It lived happily ever after,
en: It lived happily ever after,
ja: 彼女は、いつまでも幸せに暮らしました、

key: In the joy it brought, and the hearts it touched, and the smiles it inspired in its final moments as a shooting star.
en: In the joy it brought, and the hearts it touched, and the smiles it inspired in its final moments as a shooting star.
ja: 流れ星としての最後の瞬間にもたらした喜びの中で、触れた心の中で、生んだ微笑みの中で。

key: So even with its last little itty bitty bit of life,
en: So even with its last little itty bitty bit of life,
ja: だから、命のほんのちっちゃな最後のかけらでさえ、

key: It never, ever regretted what it had done, even once.
en: It never, ever regretted what it had done, even once.
ja: 彼女は自分のしたことを、一度たりとも後悔しませんでした。

key: So, make sure to smile for me too, okay?
en: So, make sure to smile for me too, okay?
ja: だから、わたしの分も、ちゃんと笑っててね?

key: HEATHER: Do you really think you can get away with this, you dirty old man!?
en: HEATHER: Do you really think you can get away with this, you dirty old man!?
ja: ヘザー: こんなことして、無事で済むと思ってんの、このエロジジイ!?

key: SIGMUND: Ah-- she scratched me.
en: SIGMUND: Ah-- she scratched me.
ja: シグムンド: ああ――引っかかれたな。

key: Restrain her.
en: Restrain her.
ja: 拘束しろ。

key: And make that 110 volts instead.
en: And make that 110 volts instead.
ja: それと、110ボルトに変更だ。

key: SIGMUND: Now, Heather, just hold still.
en: SIGMUND: Now, Heather, just hold still.
ja: シグムンド: さあヘザー、じっとしていろ。

key: You might feel a little shock...
en: You might feel a little shock...
ja: 少し、ビリッとするかもしれないが……

key: KIKI: How is it FAIR that I had to be the one to go!?
en: KIKI: How is it FAIR that I had to be the one to go!?
ja: キキ: なんで、いなくならなきゃいけなかったのがわたしなの、それのどこがフェアなわけ!?

key: How is it FAIR that my body had to be the one KILLING itself?!
en: How is it FAIR that my body had to be the one KILLING itself?!
ja: なんで、自分の体が自分を殺していかなきゃいけなかったの、それのどこがフェアなの?!

key: I DIDN'T ASK FOR THIS.
en: I DIDN'T ASK FOR THIS.
ja: こんなの頼んでない。

key: Do you think I was SATISFIED?
en: Do you think I was SATISFIED?
ja: わたしが満足してたとでも思う?

key: Do you think I didn't have DREAMS?!
en: Do you think I didn't have DREAMS?!
ja: わたしに夢がなかったとでも思う?!

key: Do you think I knew a SINGLE GODDAMN THING about staying CALM?!
en: Do you think I knew a SINGLE GODDAMN THING about staying CALM?!
ja: わたしが「冷静でいる」なんてこと、ちょっとでも分かってたとでも思う?!

key: Defeat the inner chaos?
en: Defeat the inner chaos?
ja: 内なるこんとんを打ち破る?

key: I AM MADE OF CHAOS!
en: I AM MADE OF CHAOS!
ja: わたし自身がこんとんでできてるのに!

key: AND THERE'S NOTHING I CAN DO ABOUT THAT!
en: AND THERE'S NOTHING I CAN DO ABOUT THAT!
ja: それについて、わたしにできることなんて何もないのに!

key: Unlike these whiny, self-absorbed children whose greatest problem is what their FUCKING HAIR looks like.
en: Unlike these whiny, self-absorbed children whose greatest problem is what their FUCKING HAIR looks like.
ja: 髪型が気に入らないのが一番の悩みみたいな、あの泣き言ばかりの自己中な子供たちとは違って。

key: They have NO idea what it's like to wake up one day and suddenly hear that despite EVERYTHING they have EVER sought to do with their life,
en: They have NO idea what it's like to wake up one day and suddenly hear that despite EVERYTHING they have EVER sought to do with their life,
ja: あの子たちは、ある日突然、自分の人生でずっと追い求めてきた全てにもかかわらず、

key: Despite giving themselves to others every step of the way,
en: Despite giving themselves to others every step of the way,
ja: ずっと他人のために自分をささげ続けてきたにもかかわらず、

key: Despite surviving a "family" that communicated mainly in drugs and violence,
en: Despite surviving a "family" that communicated mainly in drugs and violence,
ja: ドラッグと暴力でしか会話しないような「家族」を生き延びたにもかかわらず、

key: Despite having climbed over all of the SHIT of life just to make ONE GODDAMN OASIS of serenity in this FUCKING BALLISTIC world,
en: Despite having climbed over all of the SHIT of life just to make ONE GODDAMN OASIS of serenity in this FUCKING BALLISTIC world,
ja: この狂った世界の中で、たったひとつの安らぎのオアシスを作るためだけに、人生のクソみたいなことを全部乗り越えてきたにもかかわらず、

key: The only reward you get is DEATH.
en: The only reward you get is DEATH.
ja: 手に入る報酬が「死」だけだなんて、知る由もないのよ。

key: Tear my stomach open.
en: Tear my stomach open.
ja: わたしの腹を引き裂きなさい。

key: Pick out my intestines.
en: Pick out my intestines.
ja: 腸を引きずり出しなさい。

key: Grind them into the dirt.
en: Grind them into the dirt.
ja: 土に擦り込みなさい。

key: My body would do it all on its own anyway.
en: My body would do it all on its own anyway.
ja: どうせわたしの体は、勝手にそれを全部やってのけるでしょうけど。

key: The only thing I ever taught was mercy.
en: The only thing I ever taught was mercy.
ja: わたしが教えられたのはただ、慈悲だけだった。

key: But no one could teach that to me.
en: But no one could teach that to me.
ja: だが、それを教えてくれる者はいなかった。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
